general_information.Syllabus Name: Brand Identity Design_Thiết kế nhận diện thương hiệu
general_information.Description: Description: 'The aim of this course is to equip students with the basic knowledge of Brand Identity Design: Brand basics (what is brand, brand identity, branding; brand strategy...), Brand ideals (flexibility,value, differentiation, sustainability…), Brand elements (brandmarks, wordmarks, symbol, characters…), Brand dynamics (Social media, Mobile, …; Private labeling, Brand licensing, Certification…); Brand identity design (Logotype + signature, Color, Typography, Trial applications, Presentation…), Brand book (Standards + guidelines..), (Managing, Measuring, Decision making, Intellectual property, Design management...) Objectives: '- The Branding & Identity Design course will prepare students to design and establish visual identities and brand standards across a variety of mediums. The course will help the student look beyond logo design and acquire a fundamental understanding of the aspects of designing a brand system that is scalable and replicable, regardless of application '- Throughout this course, emphasis will be placed on the use of logo, including its use as a valuable analytical tool for the visual communication professions. Teaching method: Under lecturer’s instruction, through a series of instruction sessions, researchanalysis and personal exercises, students will be equipped with knowledge and skills to develop and complete a brand identity system
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use personal laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website https://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date information and material of the course - Wacom or digital drawing tools is suggested but not required
general_information.Tools: 1. The school prepare: (Installed) - Classroom with chairs, desks, large monitor with HDMI connection for demo/presentation - Internet connection. 2. Student prepare: - Note/Sketchbooks, pens and pencils - Laptop for graphic design with Adobe Creative apps installed
